steps.en: Scaffold a Dagster project and install it
steps.zh: 用脚手架生成 Dagster 项目并安装

steps.en: Write each table or model as a decorated function; its parameters name its inputs
steps.zh: 把每张表或模型写成带装饰器的函数，参数即上游

steps.en: Builds the asset dependency graph and shows its lineage in the UI
steps.zh: 构建资产依赖图，在界面上展示血缘

steps.en: On Materialize or a schedule, runs assets in dependency order and stores outputs
steps.zh: 点 Materialize 或定时触发时，按依赖顺序运行并保存产出

steps.en: Records each materialization with metadata, so stale assets are visible
steps.zh: 记录每次物化及其元数据，过期的资产一眼可见

value.en: You can answer which data is stale, what built it and what depends on it, instead of grepping cron logs
value.zh: 哪份数据过期了、谁构建的、谁依赖它，都能直接回答，不用翻 cron 日志
